chunks: And the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me of it from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, that they two said:
Do not wash your garment from the urine of that whose meat is eaten.

key_terms.مَا يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ: that whose meat is lawful to eat

ai.seo_question: Does urine from halal animals make clothing impure in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that urine from animals whose meat is lawful to eat does not require washing from one’s garment. It is a jurisprudential text related to taharah (ritual purity) and the rulings of najasah.
